type: deterministic shop/gateway/UI protocol checks with synthetic data and recorded real OSRM failures; not live commercial provider verification

results.name: shop branches at the same building keep separate identities, addresses and details
shop selection plots its real returned point without requiring GPS or inventing a route
selected shop destination uses GPS and provider road geometry for guidance
guidance blocks shop queries, more results and external search actions
explicit more-results requests exclude old identifiers and stop at eighteen
nearby shop search uses explicit bounds and rejects distant city results
missing shops clear old results and offer an explicitly external search
empty joined Korean locality retries spacing once and paging keeps the resolved query
a successful original business search never retries or broadens its city
an unregistered business stops after one spacing retry without invented results
private search gateway receives only its access token and never forwards it to routing or storage
a full provider page outside the nearby circle still permits the next explicit page
offline shop selection keeps the returned pin and does not invent an online route
recorded real cross-ocean OSRM success is rejected because its origin is thousands of kilometres away
route provider HTTP rejection leaves the selected shop pin without a fabricated road
